cause_quote: The ledger switched both history readers to `withExistingOpenClawStateDatabaseArtifactPreservingReadOnly`, which synchronously prepared a snapshot on cold reads and blocked the Gateway event loop.
user_saw: Opening update history or a run’s details could pause other Gateway requests when the shared-state database was closed.
summary: The fix makes the Gateway’s update history RPCs await artifact-preserving snapshot preparation so other requests can continue during a cold read.
reasoning: The history RPCs already existed before #138917, and I checked that their cold reads opened the existing database directly without preparing a snapshot. The #138917 diff routed both RPCs through synchronous snapshot preparation, adding the blocking work that the fix’s authenticated RPC test targets.
